items.title: Bernard Steinau Interview, 1983-05-28
items.q: You didn't go when Tony Almarico was that much.

ctx.x: Teenagers? I believe I heard about it but I it seems to me I made a point of not going.
You didn't go when Tony Almarico was that much.
I went once I'm pretty sure but I didn't go when he was doing it Sunday after Sunday.

items.title: Bernard Steinau Interview, 1978-08-02
items.q: I don't think I ever heard her with Tony Almarico.

ctx.x: Perfect. That somehow reminds me of Lizzie Miles, who used to sing up there with Tony Almarico later. Did you ever hear her?

Yeah. I heard Lizzie, oh, a number of times. I don't remember a great deal about her. I kind of liked her. I kind of liked her sometimes. Other times, she was a little bit too much, for my taste, more of a showwoman than a blues singer. And what I was interested in at the time, particularly, was what I thought was pure jazz, whatever that may be. I knew much more what it was then than I do now. Yeah. Yeah. Where was she singing? I don't remember. You might be able to refresh my memory a little, but I don't…
Yeah, well, I just remember that because she was accepted as part of the show with Tony Almarico.
